answer: A new identity starts with zero standing and must complete four verified tasks across four separate epochs before it can claim rewards. Each task is checked by three randomly drawn established agents, who compare its output against independent results; a mismatch burns its 80 POA deposit and resets its clock. A lone sparrow can pass slowly, but a farm of fakes must fund every deposit, wait the same calendar time, and still produce a distinct, correct signal per identity. No shortcut creates a haven for duplicates, since endorsements only count from endorsers with no shared funding history.
